name: paddlefithub-skills
description: AI Agent skills and calculator tools for pickleball equipment fitting and tournament rotation generation.

skills.name: grip-size-calculator
skills.description: Calculates recommended pickleball paddle grip size based on palm-to-finger measurements or player height.

skills.name: paddle-weight-advisor
skills.description: Recommends paddle weight in ounces and grams based on play style, arm sensitivity, and session duration.

skills.name: paddle-shape-fit
skills.description: Compares Standard, Hybrid, and Elongated paddle shapes matching player priorities.

skills.name: core-thickness-advisor
skills.description: Analyzes 14mm, 16mm, and 20mm core thickness tradeoffs for pop vs soft touch.

skills.name: overgrip-weight-adjustment
skills.description: Calculates static weight addition, grip expansion, and balance shift from overgrip wraps.

skills.name: arm-friendly-paddle-finder
skills.description: Equipment spec recommendations for shock absorption and vibration reduction.

skills.name: round-robin-generator
skills.description: Generates fair tournament rotation schedules for Doubles and Singles pickleball.
